newsitem.title: USA: NJ Turnpike amends plan,no toll increases thru '98.
newsitem.headline: NJ Turnpike amends plan,no toll increases thru '98.

text.p: The six member commission of New Jersey Turnpike Authority, acting on better than expected revenue gains in 1996, on Tuesday voted to amend its three-year financial plan, which includes no toll increases through 1998.

The commission meeting here adopted the amended 1996-1998 financial plan based in part upon improved traffic and toll revenue collections in 1996. In addition, the amended plan shows a drop in the projected structural operating deficit to $21 million from $70 million in 1998.

Overall traffic volume increased 2.9 percent in 1996, 1.9 percent greater than the projected one percent increase in the original three year plan adopted in December 1995. Commercial traffic increased 3.7 percent over 1995's performance.
Toll revenues in 1996 showed significant gains over 1995, increasing 3.1 percent over 1995, and 2.1 percent over the 1996 projection of one percent.
The authority ended 1996 by meeting its operating budget of $164 million.
The 1996 operating budget represented a 7.1 percent decrease from 1995 and the 1997 operating budget represents a 0.8 percent decrease from 1996 expenses.
